px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_index_daily_data(s,days=3600)
 if d is not None and len(d): px[s]=d.set_index('date')['close']
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# acceleration: medium trend minus slow trend, normalized by recent downside risk
rows={h:[] for h in [5,10,20]}; dates=[]; cov=[]; vals=[]
for i in range(80,len(P)-20):
 x=R.iloc[:i]
 # 20d trend versus 60d trend; downside risk and volatility stabilize cross-asset comparison
 r20=P.iloc[i-1]/P.iloc[i-21]-1; r60=P.iloc[i-1]/P.iloc[i-61]-1
 down=x.iloc[-20:].clip(upper=0).std().replace(0,np.nan)
 sig=(r20-r60/3)/(down*np.sqrt(20)+0.01)
 fwd=P.iloc[i:i+20].iloc[-1]/P.iloc[i-1]-1
 for h in [5,10,20]:
  fr=P.iloc[i+h-1]/P.iloc[i-1]-1
  z=pd.concat([sig,fr],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows[h].append(z[0].corr(z[1],method='spearman'))
 dates.append(P.index[i]); cov.append(sig.notna().sum()/len(U)); vals.append(sig)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 a=np.array(rows[h]); a=a[np.isfinite(a)]
 print(h,'n',len(a),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan,'hit',np.mean(a>0))
for name,mask in [('recent252',np.arange(len(dates))>=len(dates)-252),('2029',pd.Series(dates).dt.year.values==2029),('2027_28',np.isin(pd.Series(dates).dt.year.values,[2027,2028]))]:
 a=np.array(rows[10]); a=a[mask[:len(a)]] if len(mask)==len(a) else a
 a=a[np.isfinite(a)]; print(name,'n',len(a),'IC',a.mean() if len(a) else np.nan,'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan)
print('dates',len(dates),'mean_coverage',np.mean(cov),'instruments',len(P.columns),'through',P.index[-1].date())

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}

p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill()
r=p.pct_change()
# interpretable: 60d risk-adjusted trend multiplied by directional consistency

mom=p.pct_change(60)
vol=r.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(40)
cons=r.rolling(60).apply(lambda z: np.mean(z>0)-0.5, raw=True)
f=mom/(vol+1e-8)*(1+2*cons)
rows=[]
for d in f.index:

    j=p.index.get_loc(d); j2=j+20
    if j2>=len(p): continue
    vals=f.loc[d]; fr=p.iloc[j2]/p.iloc[j]-1
    z=pd.concat([vals.rename('f'),fr.rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1 and z.y.nunique()>1:

 print(label,len(q),'IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(q.ic>0)))

ranks=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); valid=ranks.notna().sum(axis=1)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
    x=get_stock_daily_data(s, days=3600)
    if x is not None and len(x):
        x=x.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
        D[s]=x['close'].astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Defensive low-volatility factor: lower trailing realized volatility ranks higher.
f=-(r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(20))
rows=[]
for d in f.index:
    j=p.index.get_loc(d); j2=j+10
    if j2>=len(p): continue
    z=pd.concat([f.loc[d].rename('f'),(p.iloc[j2]/p.iloc[j]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1 and z.y.nunique()>1: rows.append((d,z.f.corr(z.y),len(z)))
a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('dates',len(a),'mean_n',a.n.mean(),'coverage',a.n.sum()/(len(a)*15))
print('IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(a.ic.mean(),a.ic.mean()/a.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a.ic>0)))
for label,q in [('online',a[a.index>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-16')]),('recent252',a.tail(252)),('2029',a[a.index.year==2029]),('2028',a[a.index.year==2028]),('2027',a[a.index.year==2027])]: print(label,len(q),'IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(q.ic>0)))
ranks=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(ranks.diff(10).abs().sum(axis=1)/ranks.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna(); print('turnover10',turn.mean())
# decay diagnostics
for h in [5,20,40]:
 rows=[]
 for d in f.index:
  j=p.index.get_loc(d); j2=j+h
  if j2>=len(p): continue
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d].rename('f'),(p.iloc[j2]/p.iloc[j]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1 and z.y.nunique()>1: rows.append(z.f.corr(z.y))
 print('decay',h,'dates',len(rows),'IC',np.mean(rows),'ICIR',np.mean(rows)/np.std(rows,ddof=1))

for h in [5,20,40]:
 z=[]

  q=pd.concat([f.loc[d].rename('f'),(p.iloc[j2]/p.iloc[j]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:z.append(q.f.corr(q.y))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
    x=get_stock_daily_data(s, days=3600)
    if x is not None and len(x):
        x=x.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
        D[s]=x['close'].astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
mom=p.pct_change(60); vol=r.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(40)
cons=r.rolling(60).apply(lambda z: np.mean(z>0)-0.5, raw=True)
f=mom/(vol+1e-8)*(1+2*cons)
rows=[]
for d in f.index:
    j=p.index.get_loc(d); j2=j+20
    if j2>=len(p): continue
    z=pd.concat([f.loc[d].rename('f'),(p.iloc[j2]/p.iloc[j]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1 and z.y.nunique()>1: rows.append((d,z.f.corr(z.y),len(z)))
a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('dates',len(a),'mean_n',a.n.mean(),'coverage',a.n.sum()/(len(a)*15))
print('IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(a.ic.mean(),a.ic.mean()/a.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a.ic>0)))
for label,q in [('recent252',a.tail(252)),('2029',a[a.index.year==2029]),('2028',a[a.index.year==2028])]: print(label,len(q),'IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(q.ic>0)))
ranks=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(ranks.diff(10).abs().sum(axis=1)/ranks.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna(); print('turnover10',turn.mean())"}

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 x=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3600)
 if x is not None and len(x):
  x=x.copy();x.date=pd.to_datetime(x.date);D[s]=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill();r=p.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv');v.date=pd.to_datetime(v.date);v=v.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).reindex(p.index).ffill()
q=v.rolling(252,min_periods=60).quantile(.25); gate=(v<q).astype(float)
f=(p.pct_change(40)/(r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8))*gate.values[:,None]
rows=[]
for d in f.index:
 j=p.index.get_loc(d);k=j+10
 if k>=len(p):continue
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d].rename('f'),(p.iloc[k]/p.iloc[j]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1 and z.y.nunique()>1:rows.append((d,z.f.corr(z.y),len(z)))
a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('dates',len(a),'mean_n',a.n.mean(),'coverage',a.n.sum()/(len(a)*15));print('IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(a.ic.mean(),a.ic.mean()/a.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a.ic>0)))
for label,x in [('online',a[a.index>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-16')]),('recent252',a.tail(252)),('2029',a[a.index.year==2029]),('2028',a[a.index.year==2028])]:
 print(label,len(x),'IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(x.ic.mean(),x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(x.ic>0)))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover10',((rr.diff(10).abs().sum(axis=1)/rr.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna()).mean())

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y'];D={}
for s in U:
 x=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3600)

q=v.rolling(252,min_periods=60).quantile(.75); gate=(v>q).astype(float);f=-(p.pct_change(10))/(r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)*gate.values[:,None]
rows=[]
for d in f.index:
 j=p.index.get_loc(d);k=j+10
 if k>=len(p):continue

 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1 and z.y.nunique()>1:rows.append((d,z.f.corr(z.y),len(z)))
a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date');print('dates',len(a),'mean_n',a.n.mean(),'coverage',a.n.sum()/(len(a)*15));print('IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(a.ic.mean(),a.ic.mean()/a.ic.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a.ic>0)))

rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover10',((rr.diff(10).abs().sum(axis=1)/rr.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna()).mean())

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
EQ=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-11-28']; R=P.pct_change()
# Breadth-conditioned downside-volatility reversal: buy recent losers during broad equity weakness,
# scaling each reversal by its own downside volatility.
eqret=P[EQ].pct_change(40); breadth=(eqret>0).mean(axis=1)
# use lagged/observable breadth state at signal date; indicator is intentionally broad and slow
state=(breadth<0.375).astype(float)
down=R.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=(-P.pct_change(10)/(down+1e-12))*state.replace(0,np.nan)
F=F.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=breadth_downside_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date(),'active_dates',int(state.sum()))
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.asarray(vals); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates); sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-11-28'),('recent','2028-11-15','2029-11-28')]:
  z=x[(ds>=lo)&(ds<=hi)]; print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6) if len(z)>1 else None)
print('turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol',0:'signal'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291129_breadth_downside_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_index_daily_data(s,4000) for s in U}
# Tail-resilience: medium trend, rewarding upside capture and penalizing downside volatility.
# factor at t = 40d return / (downside vol 40d + eps), plus asymmetry via upside/downside vol.
def calc(s, h):
 d=D[s].copy(); c=d['close'].astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(40).std(); up=r.where(r>0,0).rolling(40).std()
 f=(c/c.shift(40)-1)/(down+1e-8) * (1+up/(down+1e-8)).clip(0.5,2.5)
 fr=c.shift(-h)/c-1
 return pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'fr':fr},index=pd.to_datetime(d['date']))
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 rows=[]
 for s in U:
  x=calc(s,h); x['s']=s; rows.append(x)
 z=pd.concat(rows).reset_index(names='date').dropna()
 vals=[]; dates=[]
 for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):
  if len(g)>=8:
   vals.append(g['f'].corr(g['fr'],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna()
 print(f'h={h} dates={len(q)} mean_n={z.groupby("date").size().mean():.2f} IC={q.mean():.6f} ICIR={q.mean()/q.std():.6f} hit={(q>0).mean():.4f}')
# turnover / coverage at 10d decision dates approximated rank signal changes daily
x=[]
for s in U:
 y=calc(s,10); y['s']=s;x.append(y)
z=pd.concat(x).reset_index(names='date').pivot(index='date',columns='s',values='f').rank(axis=1,pct=True)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-12-26']; R=P.pct_change(); r20=P.pct_change(20)
# zeros retain non-down days, so downside dispersion has adequate history
neg=R.clip(upper=0).fillna(0); down=neg.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std(); disp=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
basef=-(r20/(down+1e-8)); med=disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median(); gate=(disp/(med+1e-8)).clip(0.5,2.0)
F=basef.mul(gate,axis=0); F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate dispersion_gated_downside_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8:
   c=a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if np.isfinite(c): vals.append(c);dates.append(dt);ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.asarray(vals); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates); sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-12-26'),('recent','2028-12-27','2029-12-26')]:
  z=x[(ds>=lo)&(ds<=hi)]; zs=z.std(ddof=1); print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs>0 else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
out=F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291227_dispersion_gated_downside_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

### Explored Factors

- **Dispersion-gated downside-volatility reversal at 5-day horizon**
  - Reversed the 20-day return.
  - Scaled by 30-day downside volatility.
  - Applied a cross-asset dispersion gate based on 20-day realized volatility relative to its 120-day median.
  - Winsorized signals cross-sectionally at the 5th and 95th percentiles.
  - Evaluated across all 15 tradable instruments, requiring at least 8 valid instruments per date.

- **Same factor at 10-day horizon**
  - Tested to assess signal decay and compatibility with the 10-trading-day decision cycle.

- **Short-horizon variants at 1- and 3-day horizons**
  - Tested for faster predictive decay and potential timing usefulness.

### Validation Results

Validation date: **2030-01-10**  
Data available through: **2030-01-09**

| Horizon | Dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 day | 2,185 | 14.44 | 96.29% | 0.009301 | 0.030055 | 51.62% | Failed ICIR |
| 3 days | 1,540 | 14.52 | 96.79% | 0.005245 | 0.016691 | 52.40% | Failed IC and ICIR |
| 5 days | 1,539 | 14.48 | 96.53% | 0.025824 | 0.083379 | 55.75% | Failed ICIR narrowly |
| 10 days | 1,534 | 14.50 | 96.64% | 0.016043 | 0.052679 | 52.15% | Failed ICIR |

Admission thresholds: absolute IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

The 5-day variant remained economically promising, but its updated ICIR of **0.083379** was just below the binding threshold. The 10-day version showed weaker stability and did not qualify.

Regime results for the 5-day version:

- Early period: IC **-0.020111**, ICIR **-0.058892**
- Mid period: IC **0.011599**, ICIR **0.034170**
- Online period: IC **0.045968**, ICIR **0.161682**
- Recent one-year period: IC **0.041634**, ICIR **0.140955**

The signal continues to work primarily in the online and recent regimes, while exhibiting material negative performance during early warm-up history.

### Persistence Actions

- **No new factor persisted.**
- The candidate was not marked effective because the updated 5-day ICIR failed the admission gate.
- No existing factor record was overwritten or promoted.
- Signal artifacts were generated for the tested variants:
  - `scripts/miner_2_20300110_dispersion_gated_downside_reversal_5d_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20300110_dispersion_gated_downside_reversal_10d_signal.csv`

### Current Effective Factors

No newly validated effective factor from this cycle.

The previously admitted dispersion-gated downside-volatility reversal factor should be treated as requiring monitoring/revalidation because its current full-history 5-day ICIR is marginally below the benchmark threshold. Its online and recent-regime results remain strong, but its historical stability is not sufficient for renewed admission under the current gate.

### Plans

- Re-test the factor with a more stable dispersion normalization, such as a rolling percentile or exponentially weighted median.
- Evaluate whether conditioning only on elevated dispersion improves full-history ICIR without overfitting the online regime.
- Explore orthogonal combinations with residual reversal or defensive low-volatility signals.
- Revalidate the factor after additional observations, with special attention to whether the ICIR recovers above **0.0840**.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2030-01-23']; R=P.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled medium-term reversal, with no future data: signal at t predicts t+1...t+h.
r20=P.pct_change(20); v20=R.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)
F=-r20/(v20+1e-8)
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=relative_vol_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.asarray(vals,float); ok=np.isfinite(x); x=x[ok]; ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)[ok]; ns=np.asarray(ns)[ok]
 sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(ns.mean(),2),'coverage',round(ns.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2030-01-23'),('recent','2029-01-24','2030-01-23')]:
  z=x[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(hi))]; zs=z.std(ddof=1)
  print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover_rank_abs_change',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300124_relative_vol_reversal_10d_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-03-07')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)
# Relative, risk-adjusted medium-term momentum: 60d return versus its own risk,
# demeaned cross-sectionally to remove common market direction; lag one completed day.
raw=p.pct_change(60)/vol
f=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis=0).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean().shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==40:
  for name,sl in [('early',a[a.date<='2023-12-31']),('middle',a[(a.date>='2024-01-01')&(a.date<='2026-12-31')]),('late',a[a.date>='2027-01-01'])]:
   print(name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))
# lagged cross-sectional signal turnover proxy
x=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turnover=(x.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)/2).dropna()
print('turnover_proxy',round(turnover.mean(),6),'signal_dates',int(f.notna().any(axis=1).sum()))
out=f; out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300307_relative_risk_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-03-21')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
# Nonlinear extreme relative reversal: emphasize tails of 20d cross-sectional relative returns,
# while retaining direction; lag one completed session.
r20=p.pct_change(20)
rel=r20.sub(r20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
rk=rel.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
# centered rank reversal, magnitude-weighted to prioritize unusually large relative moves
f=-(rk-0.5)*(2*abs(rk-0.5)).pow(0.75)
f=f.rolling(3,min_periods=2).mean().shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==40:
  for name,sl in [('early',a[a.date<='2023-12-31']),('middle',a[(a.date>='2024-01-01')&(a.date<='2026-12-31')]),('late',a[a.date>='2027-01-01'])]:
   print(name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))
x=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turnover=(x.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)/2).dropna()
print('turnover_proxy',round(turnover.mean(),6),'signal_dates',int(f.notna().any(axis=1).sum()))
f.index.name='date'; f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300321_extreme_relative_reversal_signal.csv')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Trend persistence: lagged 20d return times fraction of positive daily returns over preceding 60d.
# This rewards persistent directional moves rather than one-off jumps.
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,2100) for s in U}
frames=[]
for s,d in D.items():
 if d is None or len(d)<200: continue
 x=d.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); x=x.set_index('date').sort_index()
 r=x['close'].pct_change()
 f=(x.close.pct_change(20).shift(1))*((r.rolling(60).mean().shift(1))/(r.rolling(60).std().shift(1)+1e-12))
 # use trend consistency ratio, but sign remains momentum
 f2=x.close.pct_change(20).shift(1)*(2*(r.rolling(60).gt(0).mean().shift(1))-1)
 frames.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':x.index,'symbol':s,'f':f2.values,'r1':x.close.pct_change(1).shift(-1).values,'r10':x.close.pct_change(10).shift(-10).values,'r20':x.close.pct_change(20).shift(-20).values,'r40':x.close.pct_change(40).shift(-40).values}))
z=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True)
for h in ['r1','r10','r20','r40']:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):
  q=g[['f',h]].dropna()
  if len(q)>=8:
   vals.append(q.f.corr(q[h],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(vals); a=a[np.isfinite(a)]
 print(h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(np.mean(a),6),'ICIR',round(np.mean(a)/(np.std(a,ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(len(a)),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
# turnover proxy based on top/bottom rank changes
print('symbols',len(frames),'rows',len(z),'date_range',z.date.min(),z.date.max())

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,2100) for s in U}; frames=[]
for s,d in D.items():
 if d is None or len(d)<200: continue
 x=d.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); x=x.set_index('date').sort_index(); r=x.close.pct_change()
 consistency=(r>0).astype(float).rolling(60).mean().shift(1)

z=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True)
for h in ['r1','r10','r20','r40']:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,2100) for s in U}; frames=[]
for s,d in D.items():
 if d is None or len(d)<200: continue
 x=d.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); x=x.set_index('date').sort_index(); r=x.close.pct_change()
 consistency=(r>0).astype(float).rolling(60).mean().shift(1)
 f2=x.close.pct_change(20).shift(1)*(2*consistency-1)
 frames.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':x.index,'symbol':s,'signal':f2.values,'r1':x.close.pct_change(1).shift(-1).values,'r10':x.close.pct_change(10).shift(-10).values,'r20':x.close.pct_change(20).shift(-20).values,'r40':x.close.pct_change(40).shift(-40).values}))
z=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True); z[['date','symbol','signal']].dropna().to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300418_trend_consistency_signal.csv',index=False)
for h in ['r1','r10','r20','r40']:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):
  q=g[['signal',h]].dropna()
  if len(q)>=8: vals.append(q.signal.corr(q[h],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(vals); a=a[np.isfinite(a)]
 print(h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(np.mean(a),6),'ICIR',round(np.mean(a)/(np.std(a,ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(len(a)),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
print('symbols',len(frames),'rows',len(z),'date_range',z.date.min(),z.date.max())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-05-01')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); r20=p.pct_change(20)
# Breadth-conditioned relative momentum: lagged cross-sectional breadth determines
# whether recent relative winners are followed (positive breadth) or faded (negative breadth).
breadth=(r>0).mean(axis=1).rolling(10,min_periods=8).mean()
rel=r20.sub(r20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
sig=(rel*(2*breadth-1)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 for name,sl in [('early',a.loc[:'2023-12-31']),('middle',a.loc['2024-01-01':'2026-12-31']),('late',a.loc['2027-01-01':])]:
  print(' ',name,len(sl),round(sl.ic.mean(),6) if len(sl) else None,round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6) if len(sl)>1 else None)
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)/2).mean()
print('turnover_proxy',round(turn,6))
sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300502_breadth_conditioned_relative_momentum_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-05-01')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.rename(s) for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D.values(),axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); r20=p.pct_change(20)
breadth=(r>0).mean(axis=1).rolling(10,min_periods=8).mean()
rel=r20.sub(r20.median(axis=1),axis='index')
sig=(rel*(2*breadth-1)).shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 for name,sl in [('early',a.loc[:'2023-12-31']),('middle',a.loc['2024-01-01':'2026-12-31']),('late',a.loc['2027-01-01':])]:
  print(' ',name,len(sl),round(sl.ic.mean(),6) if len(sl) else None,round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6) if len(sl)>1 else None)
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)/2).mean()
print('turnover_proxy',round(turn,6))
sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300502_breadth_conditioned_relative_momentum_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-05-16')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); med=r.median(axis=1)
# Contrarian relative return: 20d return versus cross-asset median, normalized by idiosyncratic vol.
rel=p.pct_change(20)-p.pct_change(20).median(axis=1)
vol=r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(20)
sig=(-rel/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in p.index:
 for_h=[]
 for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
  y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
  for dt in p.index:
   z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
   if len(z)>=8:
    q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
    if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
  a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
  print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
  for name,sl in [('2020-2023',a.loc[:'2023-12-31']),('2024-2026',a.loc['2024-01-01':'2026-12-31']),('2027-2030',a.loc['2027-01-01':])]:
   print(' ',name,len(sl),round(sl.ic.mean(),6) if len(sl) else None,round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6) if len(sl)>1 else None)
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover_proxy',round((rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)/2).mean(),6))
sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300516_volscaled_relative_reversal_signal.csv')

p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); med=r.median(axis=1)

rel=(r.sub(med,axis=0)).rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
short=(r.sub(med,axis=0)).rolling(5,min_periods=4).sum()

agree=np.sign(short)*np.sign(long)
f=rel.div(vol+1e-8).mul(agree).shift(1)
rows=[]

 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))

   print(name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))

## Explored Factors

1. **Horizon-Agreement Relative Trend**
   - Volatility-scaled 20-day relative trend versus the cross-sectional median.
   - Multiplied by the agreement of short-term (5-day) and long-term (60-day) relative trends.
   - One-day lag applied to avoid look-ahead.
   - Failed admission: daily IC −0.034996 and ICIR −0.135509 at the 40-day horizon.

2. **Inverse Horizon-Agreement Relative Trend**
   - Inverted the preceding signal, favoring relative-trend disagreement and reversal candidates.
   - Uses close prices only and all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - One-day lag applied.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2030-05-30**  
Data period: **2020-01-01 through 2030-05-29**

| Horizon | Dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| 20d | 962 | 14.99 | 99.96% | 0.012328 | 0.050178 | 51.35% |
| 40d | 942 | 14.99 | 99.96% | **0.034996** | **0.135509** | 54.46% |
| 60d | 922 | 14.99 | 99.96% | 0.062882 | 0.232656 | 58.79% |

Regime checks for the 40-day horizon:

- 2024–2026: IC 0.097011, ICIR 0.455238, hit ratio 64.52%, 93 dates.
- 2027–2030: IC 0.028203, ICIR 0.107667, hit ratio 53.36%, 849 dates.
- The early 2020–2023 subperiod was unavailable for the complete 60-day construction in the evaluated artifact.

The inverse factor passed the benchmark admission gates of absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840. Its 15-instrument coverage was effectively complete. Library signal-artifact correlation scanning found no usable overlapping artifacts, so the reported maximum absolute correlation was 0.0; the small cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20300530_inverse_horizon_agreement_40d.json`
- Status: **EFFECTIVE**
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20300530_inverse_horizon_agreement_signal.csv`
- JSON reload and required metadata validation succeeded.

The non-inverted candidate was not persisted because it failed the admission gates.

## Current Effective Factors

The newly validated effective factor is:

- **miner_2_20300530_inverse_horizon_agreement_40d**
  - 40-day IC: 0.034996
  - 40-day ICIR: 0.135509
  - Coverage: 99.96%
  - Validation recency: 2030-05-30
  - Stronger 60-day decay result: IC 0.062882, ICIR 0.232656

Existing effective factors remain unchanged.

## Plans

- Revalidate this factor over the next approximately three months, emphasizing post-2030 performance drift.
- Investigate whether the factor adds incremental value to the existing reversal and breadth-trend ensemble.
- Test turnover and portfolio-level contribution before recommending production inclusion.
- Explore conditional versions gated by stress breadth or volatility regimes, while retaining simple and interpretable constructions.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-07-10')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].rename(s) for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]; r=p.pct_change()
# Downside-skew reversal: reverse recent relative performance, but penalize assets
# whose recent downside volatility is large; smooth and lag to avoid lookahead.
med=r.median(axis=1); rel=r.sub(med,axis=0)
down=r.where(r<0).rolling(15,min_periods=8).std()
allvol=r.rolling(15,min_periods=8).std()
# asymmetric risk normalization: downside vol receives extra weight
risk=(0.5*allvol+0.5*down).replace(0,np.nan)
f=(-rel.rolling(15,min_periods=10).sum()/risk).rolling(3,min_periods=2).mean().shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']); ic=a.ic.mean(); ir=ic/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(ic,6),'ICIR',round(ir,6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==40:
  for name,sl in [('2020-2023',a[(a.date>='2020-01-01')&(a.date<='2023-12-31')]),('2024-2026',a[(a.date>='2024-01-01')&(a.date<='2026-12-31')]),('2027-2030',a[a.date>='2027-01-01'])]:
   print(name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover_proxy',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
f.index.name='date'; f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300711_downside_skew_reversal_signal.csv')

## Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-Scaled Relative Trend**
   - Measures each asset’s 20-day cumulative return relative to the cross-sectional median.
   - Scales relative momentum by 20-day realized volatility.
   - Applies three-day smoothing and a one-session lag to prevent lookahead.
   - Intended to capture persistent relative trends while controlling risk.

2. **Relative Return Acceleration Reversal**
   - Compares five-day relative return momentum with one-sixth of the 30-day relative trend.
   - Reverses the acceleration component to identify short-term exhaustion or pullback opportunities.
   - Volatility-normalized, smoothed, and lagged by one session.

# Cross-asset downside-shock reversal: recent losses relative to own downside risk,

for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150:
  q=d[['date','close','volume']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); data[s]=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).sort_index()
v=pd.DataFrame({s:x.volume.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).reindex(p.index)
r=p.pct_change()
# Liquidity-adjusted short shock: relative 10d underperformance, scaled by downside risk,
# and weighted by abnormal volume so capitulation/reversal events are distinguished.
ret10=p.pct_change(10); rel=ret10.sub(ret10.median(axis=1),axis=0)
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
volratio=v.rolling(20).mean().div(v.rolling(60).mean()).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
f=(-rel/down*volratio.clip(0.5,2.0)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; vals=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
 a=pd.Series(vals,index=dates).dropna(); ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan
 print(f'H={h} dates={len(a)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} coverage={np.mean(ns)/len(U):.4f} IC={ic:.6f} ICIR={ir:.6f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.4f}')
fr=p.shift(-20).div(p)-1; vals=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')))
a=pd.Series(dict(vals)).sort_index()
for lo,hi,nm in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31','2024-26'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31','2027-29'),('2030-01-01','2030-10-30','2030YTD')]:
 q=a.loc[lo:hi]; print(f'regime={nm} dates={len(q)} IC={q.mean():.6f} ICIR={q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(q)) if len(q)>1 else np.nan:.6f}')
print(f'turnover_proxy={f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean():.6f} instruments={len(data)} dates={len(p)} avg_factor_N={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean():.2f}')
f.index=f.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301031_liquidity_adjusted_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150:
  q=d[['date','close']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); data[s]=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).sort_index()
r=p.pct_change()
ret60=p.pct_change(60)
vol20=r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
vol60=r.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Trend persistence: risk-adjusted 60d return, rewarded when recent volatility is compressed
compression=(vol60/vol20).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(0.5,2.0)
f=(ret60/vol60*compression).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; vals=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
 a=pd.Series(vals,index=dates).dropna(); ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan
 print(f'H={h} dates={len(a)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} coverage={np.mean(ns)/len(U):.4f} IC={ic:.6f} ICIR={ir:.6f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.4f}')
fr=p.shift(-20).div(p)-1; vals=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')))
a=pd.Series(dict(vals)).sort_index()
for lo,hi,nm in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31','2024-26'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31','2027-29'),('2030-01-01','2030-11-13','2030YTD')]:
 q=a.loc[lo:hi]; print(f'regime={nm} dates={len(q)} IC={q.mean():.6f} ICIR={q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(q)) if len(q)>1 else np.nan:.6f}')
print(f'turnover_proxy={f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean():.6f} instruments={len(data)} dates={len(p)} avg_factor_N={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean():.2f}')
f.index=f.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301114_compressed_trend_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

data={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)

  q=d[['date','close','volume']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); data[s]=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()

v=pd.DataFrame({s:x.volume.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).reindex(p.index)
r=p.pct_change()
# Reversal of recent losses, enhanced when the loss occurred on unusually high volume;
# volume surprise is clipped and lagged with the price signal.
volsur=(v/v.rolling(20,min_periods=10).median()-1).clip(-0.8,3.0)
f=(-p.pct_change(10)* (1+0.35*volsur)).shift(1)

  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z))
 a=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>100:
  q=d[['date','close','volume']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); data[s]=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).sort_index()
v=pd.DataFrame({s:x.volume.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).reindex(p.index)
# Volume surprise amplifies reversal only when recent weakness was unusual in activity.
volsur=(v/v.rolling(20,min_periods=10).median()-1).clip(-0.8,3.0)
f=(-p.pct_change(10)*(1+0.35*volsur)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z))
 a=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan
 print(f'H={h} dates={len(a)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} coverage={np.mean(ns)/len(U):.4f} IC={ic:.6f} ICIR={ir:.6f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.4f}')
print(f'turnover_proxy={f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean():.6f} instruments={len(data)} dates={len(p)} avg_factor_N={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean():.2f}')
f.index=f.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301128_volume_shock_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>100:
  q=d[['date','close']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); data[s]=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).sort_index()
r=p.pct_change()
# Trend efficiency: directional 60d move divided by path length, scaled by recent risk.
# Lag one day so the signal uses only completed data.
direction=p.pct_change(60)
path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum()
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(direction/(path+1e-12) / (vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z))
 a=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.nan
 print(f'H={h} dates={len(a)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} coverage={np.mean(ns)/len(U):.4f} IC={ic:.6f} ICIR={ir:.6f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.4f}')
print(f'turnover_proxy={f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean():.6f} instruments={len(data)} dates={len(p)} avg_factor_N={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean():.2f}')
f.index=f.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301212_efficiency_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
data={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>100:
  q=d[['date','close']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); data[s]=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.astype(float) for s,x in data.items()}).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
direction=p.pct_change(60); path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Fade smooth, efficient 60d trends: negative trend efficiency, scaled by recent risk; lag one day.
f=(-direction/(path+1e-12)/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z))
 a=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(a))
 print(f'H={h} dates={len(a)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} coverage={np.mean(ns)/len(U):.4f} IC={ic:.6f} ICIR={ir:.6f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.4f}')
print(f'turnover_proxy={f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean():.6f} instruments={len(data)} dates={len(p)} avg_factor_N={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean():.2f}')
f.index=f.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301212_efficiency_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

## Explored Factors

1. **Drawdown-Recovery Reversal**
   - Construction: 120-day drawdown magnitude multiplied by a 10-day recovery signal and scaled by inverse 30-day volatility.
   - Signal was lagged one trading day.
   - Motivation: identify deeply drawdown assets beginning to recover while controlling risk.
   - Universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Minimum cross-section: 8 instruments.

2. **90-Day Risk-Adjusted Momentum**
   - Construction: 90-day cumulative return divided by 30-day realized volatility.
   - Signal was lagged one trading day.
   - Motivation: capture medium-term trend persistence while penalizing volatile assets.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2031-01-23**  
Data used through the latest available completed trading day.  
The scripts used approximately 3,000 historical observations per asset where available.

### Drawdown-Recovery Reversal

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 1,454 | 12.76 | 85.09% | -0.016799 | -0.044867 | 48.97% |
| 10d | 1,446 | 12.75 | 85.03% | -0.025194 | -0.070660 | 48.48% |

| 40d | 1,413 | 12.74 | 84.95% | -0.059300 | -0.165004 | 44.16% |
| 60d | 1,384 | 12.76 | 85.06% | -0.080985 | -0.213254 | 41.47% |

Regime results at the 60-day horizon were also negative:

- 2024–2026: IC **-0.070796**, ICIR **-0.206730**
- 2027–2029: IC **-0.092512**, ICIR **-0.259461**
- 2030: IC **-0.002540**, ICIR **-0.006519**

Turnover proxy: **0.107921**.  
**Result: Failed** admission criteria because both IC and ICIR were negative.

### 90-Day Risk-Adjusted Momentum

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 1,482 | 12.80 | 85.35% | -0.050255 | -0.152895 | 44.40% |
| 10d | 1,475 | 12.78 | 85.19% | -0.075355 | -0.231197 | 40.00% |
| 20d | 1,463 | 12.80 | 85.36% | -0.113529 | -0.351789 | 35.68% |
| 40d | 1,440 | 12.79 | 85.25% | -0.173104 | -0.498096 | 28.96% |
| 60d | 1,413 | 12.80 | 85.30% | -0.213467 | -0.609349 | 22.79% |

Regime results at the 60-day horizon:

- 2024–2026: IC **-0.602157**, ICIR **-2.629519**
- 2027–2029: IC **-0.242405**, ICIR **-0.879601**
- 2030: IC **-0.320741**, ICIR **-1.178205**

Turnover proxy: **0.037742**.  
**Result: Failed** admission criteria. The factor exhibited a strong and persistent inverse relationship with forward returns, indicating that the tested momentum formulation behaved as a reversal signal in this benchmark.

## Persistence Actions

- No new factors were persisted.
- Neither candidate met the benchmark admission gates of absolute daily paper IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.
- Research artifacts saved:
  - `scripts/miner_2_20310123_drawdown_recovery_reversal.py`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20310123_drawdown_recovery_reversal_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20310123_riskadjusted_momentum.py`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20310123_riskadjusted_momentum_signal.csv`

## Current Effective Factors

Previously validated effective factors remain unchanged, including the recently discovered:

- `miner_3_20301226_range_position_reversal_60d`
- `miner_2_20310109_range_position_reversal_60d` as previously reported, subject to the existing signal-artifact and deterministic library-correlation audit.

No current factor was deprecated in this cycle because no existing factor was revalidated here.

## Plans

- Investigate sign inversion and conditional formulations for the risk-adjusted momentum candidate, since the negative IC is strong and consistent.
- Focus on orthogonalization against the existing range-position and volatility-managed reversal cluster.
- Test cross-asset residual signals and regime-conditioned medium-term reversal.
- Continue monitoring long-horizon reversal factors for redundancy and recent-period decay.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

UNIV=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
W=100
frames={}
for s in UNIV:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=3000)
    if d is not None and len(d)>W+70:
        d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
        frames[s]=d['close'].astype(float)
px=pd.concat(frames,axis=1).sort_index()
# Trend persistence: lagged fraction of positive daily returns, centered cross-sectionally at each date.
r=px.pct_change()
pos=(r>0).rolling(W,min_periods=80).mean().shift(1)
# mild magnitude weighting makes this an interpretable persistence/continuation measure
sig=pos
rows=[]
for dt in sig.index:
    x=sig.loc[dt].dropna()
    if len(x)<8: continue
    rec={'date':dt,'n':len(x),'signal':x}
    rows.append(rec)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
    ics=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
    for rec in rows:
        dt=rec['date']; x=rec['signal']; future=px.loc[px.index>dt].reindex(columns=x.index).head(h)
        if len(future)<h: continue
        fr=future.iloc[-1]/px.loc[dt,x.index]-1
        z=pd.concat([x,fr.rename('f')],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8 and z['signal'].nunique()>1 and z['f'].nunique()>1:
            ics.append(z['signal'].corr(z['f'],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
    a=np.array(ics); print(f'H={h} dates={len(a)} avg_n={np.mean(ns):.2f} coverage={np.mean(ns)/15:.4f} IC={np.nanmean(a):.6f} ICIR={np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1):.6f} hit={np.mean(a>0):.4f}')
    if h==20:
        out=[]
        for rec in rows:
            dt=rec['date']; x=rec['signal']; future=px.loc[px.index>dt].reindex(columns=x.index).head(h)
            if len(future)<h: continue
            fr=future.iloc[-1]/px.loc[dt,x.index]-1
            for s,v in x.items():
                if pd.notna(fr.get(s)): out.append({'date':dt,'symbol':s,'signal':v,'forward_return':fr[s]})
        pd.DataFrame(out).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310220_trend_persistence_signal.csv',index=False)
# turnover proxy
wide=sig.dropna(how='all'); ranks=wide.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print(f'TURNOVER_PROXY={turn:.6f} total_dates={len(rows)} instruments={len(frames)}')
for a,b in [("2024-01-01","2026-12-31"),("2027-01-01","2029-12-31"),("2030-01-01","2030-12-31")]:
    vals=[]
    for rec in rows:
        if not (pd.Timestamp(a)<=rec['date']<=pd.Timestamp(b)): continue
        dt=rec['date']; x=rec['signal']; fut=px.loc[px.index>dt].reindex(columns=x.index).head(20)
        if len(fut)<20: continue
        fr=fut.iloc[-1]/px.loc[dt,x.index]-1; z=pd.concat([x,fr.rename('f')],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: vals.append(z['signal'].corr(z['f'],method='spearman'))
    a=np.array(vals); print(f'REGIME {a} {len(a)} IC={np.nanmean(a) if len(a) else np.nan:.6f} ICIR={np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1) if len(a)>1 else np.nan:.6f}')

## Explored Factors

### 100-Day Inverted Positive-Session Frequency

- **Construction:** Negative of the lagged 100-session fraction of positive daily returns:
  \[
  \text{InversePersistence}_t
  =
  -\frac{1}{100}\sum_{i=1}^{100}\mathbf{1}(r_{t-i}>0)
  \]
- **Motivation:** The prior positive-direction persistence signal displayed a robust negative relationship with forward returns. This cycle explicitly tested its inverse as a long-horizon cross-asset reversal factor.
- **Universe:** 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
- **Signal timing:** One-session lagged; no future data used.
- **Signal artifact:** `scripts/miner_2_20310306_inverted_persistence_signal.csv`

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2031-03-06**

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 2,287 | 14.34 | 95.57% | 0.030979 | 0.101586 | 55.66% |

| 60d | 2,226 | 14.26 | 95.05% | 0.130326 | 0.407653 | 69.99% |

The 20-day factor passes the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: **0.064650**, above **0.0070**
- Absolute ICIR: **0.211324**, above **0.0840**
- Valid dates: **2,519**
- Average cross-section: **14.33 instruments**
- Rank-turnover proxy: **0.025937**

### Regime Analysis — 20-Day Horizon

| Regime | Valid dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024–2026 | 641 | 0.018093 | 0.051296 |
| 2027–2029 | 782 | 0.129423 | 0.547306 |
| 2030–2031 | 287 | 0.074933 | 0.300155 |

The signal was positive in all tested regimes, although the 2024–2026 subperiod had lower ICIR than the admission threshold. The full-history result is supported by extensive date coverage, but uncertainty remains due to the small 15-instrument cross-section.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20310306_inverted_persistence_100d.json`
- Status: **EFFECTIVE**
- Version: **1.0**
- Validation timestamp: **2031-03-06**

- `max_abs_library_correlation`: not computed in this cycle and recorded as `null`; deterministic library correlation should be audited downstream.

## Current Effective Factors

The newly effective factor is:

- **`miner_2_20310306_inverted_persistence_100d`**
  - 20-day IC: **0.064650**
  - ICIR: **0.211324**
  - Coverage: **95.50%**
  - Turnover proxy: **0.025937**
  - Validated: **2031-03-06**

Previously effective factors remain unchanged, including the existing trend-acceleration and macro-gated residual-reversal factors.

## Plans

- Measure deterministic pairwise correlation with existing reversal and acceleration factors.
- Revalidate the inverse persistence factor on a rolling three-month schedule.
- Test shorter inverse-frequency windows, particularly 40- and 60-session versions.
- Investigate volatility- and macro-regime-conditioned variants while preserving simple, interpretable construction.

import os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

root='../persistent/stock_data'
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for a in assets:
    d=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(root,a+'.csv'),parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[a]=d['close'].replace(0,np.nan)
prices=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_account_dict, get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
raw={}
for s in U:
    x=get_index_daily_data(s, days=3000)
    if x is not None and len(x):
        x=x.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
        raw[s]=x['close'].astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(raw).sort_index()
# common cross-section, aligned prices; factor is residual reversal versus cross-sectional median return
r20=p.pct_change(20); vol40=p.pct_change().rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
rows=[]
for i,d in enumerate(p.index):
    if i+20>=len(p): break
    vals=r20.loc[d]; vv=vol40.loc[d]
    valid=vals.notna() & vv.notna() & (vv>1e-8)
    if valid.sum()<8: continue
    med=vals[valid].median()
    # negative residual: contrarian to asset return relative to contemporaneous universe
    f=-(vals-med)/vv
    f=f[valid].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
    if len(f)<8: continue
    fut=p.iloc[i+1:i+21].iloc[-1]/p.iloc[i+1]-1
    fut=fut.reindex(f.index).dropna(); common=f.index.intersection(fut.index)
    if len(common)>=8:
        rows.append((d, f.reindex(common), fut.reindex(common)))
ics=[]; signals=[]
for d,f,y in rows:
    ic=f.corr(y, method='spearman')
    if np.isfinite(ic):
        ics.append(ic); signals.append((d,f))
ics=np.array(ics)
print('dates',len(ics),'avg_n',np.mean([len(f) for _,f,_ in rows]),'instruments',len(p.columns))
print('IC20 %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f' % (ics.mean(), ics.mean()/ics.std(ddof=1), (ics>0).mean()))
# regimes with enough history
for a,b in [('2026-01-01','2028-12-31'),('2029-01-01','2031-04-17')]:
 z=np.array([q for (d,_,_),q in zip(rows,ics) if pd.Timestamp(a)<=d<=pd.Timestamp(b)])
 print(a,b,'n',len(z),'ic', (z.mean() if len(z) else np.nan),'hit',(z>0).mean() if len(z) else np.nan)
# rank turnover proxy across adjacent observations
turn=[]
for (_,f),(_,g) in zip(signals[:-1],signals[1:]):
 c=f.index.intersection(g.index)
 if len(c)>=8: turn.append(np.mean(f[c].rank(pct=True).sub(g[c].rank(pct=True)).abs()))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f' % (np.mean([len(f)/15 for _,f,_ in rows]),np.mean(turn)))
# decay diagnostics
for h in [5,10,40]:
 z=[]
 for i,d in enumerate(p.index):
  if i+ h>=len(p): continue
  vals=r20.loc[d]; vv=vol40.loc[d]; valid=vals.notna()&vv.notna()&(vv>1e-8)
  if valid.sum()<8: continue
  f=(-(vals[valid]-vals[valid].median())/vv[valid]).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  y=(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i+1]-1).reindex(f.index).dropna(); c=f.index.intersection(y.index)
  if len(c)>=8: z.append(f[c].corr(y[c],method='spearman'))
 print('h',h,'n',len(z),'ic',np.nanmean(z),'icir',np.nanmean(z)/np.nanstd(z,ddof=1))

  \[
  -\frac{\text{20-day return} - \text{cross-sectional median 20-day return}}{\text{40-day annualized volatility}}
  \]
- **Motivation:** Isolate asset-specific relative weakness or strength rather than using absolute return alone, while normalizing risk across the 15-asset universe.
- **Universe:** All 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
- **Look-ahead control:** Signals use completed historical data and are applied with a one-session lag.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>100:D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); r=c.pct_change()
# Reversal after recent shocks, scaled by downside volatility and moderated by recovery from 20d low.
r5=c.pct_change(5); r20=c.pct_change(20)
down=r.where(r<0).rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
low20=c.rolling(20).min(); recovery=(c/low20-1).clip(-1,1)
# Favor recent losers, but avoid names already fully recovering; cross-sectional neutralization
raw=(-r5/(down+1e-12))*(1-0.35*recovery.clip(lower=0))
med=raw.median(axis=1); sig=(raw-med).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 a=[]
 for i in range(len(c)-h):
  z=pd.concat([sig.iloc[i],c.iloc[i+h]/c.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((c.index[i],z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for n,a1,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a1)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',n,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310501_shock_recovery_asymmetry_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

## Explored Factors

### Shock Recovery Asymmetry Reversal

- **Construction:** Recent 5-day return reversal, scaled by 40-day downside volatility and penalized when an asset has already recovered from its 20-day low:
  \[
  \text{Signal} =
  \operatorname{median}_{CS}(X)-X
  \]
  where
  \[
  X=
  \frac{-r_{5d}}{\sigma_{\text{down},40d}}
  \left(1-0.35\max(\text{recovery}_{20d},0)\right)
  \]
- **Motivation:** Identify oversold assets after recent shocks while avoiding assets whose rebound is already substantially underway.
- **Universe:** All 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
- **Research script:** `scripts/miner_2_20310501_shock_recovery_asymmetry.py`
- **Signal artifact:** `scripts/miner_2_20310501_shock_recovery_asymmetry_signal.csv`
- **Look-ahead control:** Signal shifted one completed session before measuring forward returns.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2031-05-01**

| Forward horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 1,975 | 12.28 | 81.85% | 0.022359 | 0.068676 | 53.32% |
| 10d | 1,778 | 12.45 | 83.00% | 0.022242 | 0.068664 | 54.44% |
| 20d | 2,116 | 12.13 | 80.85% | 0.023343 | 0.069814 | 54.91% |
| 40d | 1,934 | 12.23 | 81.55% | 0.032452 | 0.098732 | 55.95% |

The **40-day horizon** passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: **0.032452**, above 0.0070

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>120:D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); v=pd.DataFrame({s:d.volume for s,d in D.items()}); r=c.pct_change()
# Contrarian shock scaled by relative trading activity, with high activity increasing exhaustion signal.
vol40=r.rolling(40,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
activity=(v.rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()/(v.rolling(60,min_periods=20).mean()+1e-12)).clip(0.5,3.0)
raw=(-r.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum()/(vol40+1e-12))*np.sqrt(activity)
# Cross-sectional demean and lag one completed session.
sig=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 a=[]
 for i in range(len(c)-h):
  z=pd.DataFrame({'s':sig.iloc[i],'f':c.iloc[i+h]/c.iloc[i]-1}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((c.index[i],z.s.corr(z.f),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for n,a1,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a1)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',n,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310515_volume_confirmed_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150:D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); r=c.pct_change()
# Relative contrarian signal: asset's 60d return relative to contemporaneous cross-asset mean,
# scaled by idiosyncratic 40d residual volatility; lag one completed session.
csmean=r.mean(axis=1)
res=r.sub(csmean,axis=0)
rel60=res.rolling(60,min_periods=40).sum()
vol=res.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
sig=(-rel60/(vol+1e-12)).sub((-rel60/(vol+1e-12)).median(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 a=[]
 for i in range(len(c)-h):
  z=pd.DataFrame({'s':sig.iloc[i],'f':c.iloc[i+h]/c.iloc[i]-1}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((c.index[i],z.s.corr(z.f),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for n,a1,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a1)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',n,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
    d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
    if d is not None and len(d)>220: D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index()
r=c.pct_change(); csmean=r.mean(axis=1); resid=r.sub(csmean,axis=0)
res60=resid.rolling(60,min_periods=40).sum()
down=resid.clip(upper=0).pow(2).rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean().pow(.5)*np.sqrt(252)
up=resid.clip(lower=0).pow(2).rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean().pow(.5)*np.sqrt(252)
asym=((down+1e-8)/(up+1e-8)).clip(0.5,2.0)
# Contrarian residual trend, emphasizing assets with downside-dominant recent risk
sig=(-res60/(down+1e-8)*asym).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
sig=sig.sub(sig.median(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
    fwd=c.shift(-h)/c-1; rows=[]
    for dt in c.index:
        z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
    q=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']); x=q.ic
    print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
    if h==20:
        for name,a,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
            y=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',name,len(y),round(y.ic.mean(),6),round(y.ic.mean()/y.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(y)>1 else np.nan,round((y.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(y) else np.nan)
        print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310724_downside_asymmetry_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

## Explored Factors

### VIX-Conditioned Cross-Asset Relative Reversal

- **Construction:**  
  - Compute each asset’s 60-session cumulative residual log return relative to the 15-asset cross-sectional mean.
  - Invert the residual performance for contrarian exposure.
  - Multiply by a macro-conditioning multiplier:
    `0.75 + 0.75 × trailing-252-session VIX percentile rank`.
  - Lag the signal by one completed session.
  - VIX is used only as an observation-only macro signal; no orders are submitted for it.

- **Motivation:** Enhance the established relative-reversal signal during elevated market-stress regimes while maintaining an interpretable, smoothly varying exposure adjustment.

- **Research script:** `scripts/miner_2_20310807_vix_conditioned_reversal.py`
- **Signal artifact:** `scripts/miner_2_20310807_vix_conditioned_reversal_signal.csv`

The factor passed the benchmark admission gates at the 20-session horizon:

- Absolute IC: **0.150912**, above 0.0070
- Absolute ICIR: **0.483139**, above 0.0840
- Valid dates: **1,286**
- Average cross-section: **14.99 instruments**
- Minimum cross-section: **8 instruments**
- Coverage: **99.95%**
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: **null**, pending deterministic signal-artifact audit

### Regime Results at 20 Sessions

- **2024–2026:** IC +0.258852, ICIR +0.818721, 106 dates
- **2027–2029:** IC +0.122607, ICIR +0.381210, 782 dates
- **2030:** IC +0.184257, ICIR +0.618266, 261 dates
- **2031 YTD:** IC +0.165437, ICIR +0.649790, 137 dates

Predictive power was positive across all tested regimes and strengthened at longer holding horizons. Given the 15-instrument universe, uncertainty remains material despite the broad historical date coverage.

## Explored Factors

### 1. Downside-Persistence Quality

- **Construction:** Combined 60-session downside return, negative-return frequency, and downside RMS volatility. Lower downside persistence and downside risk receive higher scores.

### 2. Cross-Asset Dispersion-Conditioned Relative Reversal

- **Construction:**  
  - Calculate each asset’s 60-session cumulative residual log return relative to the cross-sectional mean.
  - Invert the residual return for contrarian exposure.
  - Scale the signal by elevated trailing cross-asset dispersion:
    `0.75 + 0.75 × percentile_rank_252(mean_60(cross-sectional return dispersion))`.
  - Lag the complete signal by one session to avoid look-ahead.
- **Motivation:** Relative reversal may be stronger when cross-asset disagreement and opportunity for mean reversion are elevated.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
raw={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=5000)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        d=d[['date','close']].copy(); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d['lr']=np.log(d.close).diff(); raw[s]=d
px=pd.concat([v.set_index('date')['lr'].rename(k) for k,v in raw.items()],axis=1).sort_index()
cs=px.mean(axis=1)
res=px.sub(cs,axis=0)
# shock recovery: contrarian residual 20d return, emphasized when short vol is elevated vs long vol
cum=res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
short=res.rolling(5,min_periods=4).std(); long=res.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
shock=(short/(long+1e-8)-1).clip(-1,3)
factor=(-cum*(1+shock.clip(lower=0))).shift(1)
fwd=px.rolling(20).sum().shift(-20)
rows=[]; dates=sorted(set(factor.index)&set(fwd.index))
for dt in dates:
    a=factor.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([a.rename('f'),b.rename('r')],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
        rows.append((dt,len(z),z.f.corr(z.r)))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna()
print('dates',len(out),'avg_n',out.n.mean(),'min_n',out.n.min(),'coverage',out.n.mean()/15)
print('IC',out.ic.mean(),'ICIR',out.ic.mean()/out.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit',(out.ic>0).mean())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
    fw=px.rolling(h).sum().shift(-h); rr=[]
    for dt in factor.index:
      z=pd.concat([factor.loc[dt].rename('f'),fw.loc[dt].rename('r')],axis=1).dropna()
      if len(z)>=8: rr.append(z.f.corr(z.r))
    x=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print('h',h,'dates',len(x),'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1))
# regime
for name,lo,hi in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-09-03')]:
 x=out[(out.date>=lo)&(out.date<=hi)].ic; print(name,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1) if len(x)>1 else np.nan)
out.assign(**{s:factor.loc[out.date,s].values for s in U}).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310918_volatility_shock_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data, get_account_dict

# Volatility-conditioned trend: medium-term risk-adjusted momentum, boosted
# when recent volatility is below its medium-term level (trend persistence regime).
watch = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
prices={}
for s in watch:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=3000)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
        prices[s]=x
px=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index().ffill()
# use only dates with enough history; signal is explicitly lagged one day
r=np.log(px).diff()
mom=np.log(px/px.shift(60))
vol20=r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
vol60=r.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# cross-sectional demean, then risk adjust and condition on compression
raw=mom/(vol60+1e-8)
cs=raw.sub(raw.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
compression=(vol20/(vol60+1e-8)).clip(0.5,2.0)
signal=(cs*(1.0+0.75*(1.0-compression))).shift(1)
# forward 20-session simple log return
fwd=np.log(px.shift(-20)/px)
ics=[]; rows=[]
for dt in signal.index:
    a=pd.concat([signal.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(a)>=8:
        ic=a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
        if np.isfinite(ic): ics.append(ic); rows.append((dt,ic,len(a)))
ser=pd.Series([x[1] for x in rows],index=[x[0] for x in rows])
print('dates',len(ser),'avg_n',np.mean([x[2] for x in rows]),'min_n',min(x[2] for x in rows))
print('IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.6f'%(ser.mean(),ser.mean()/ser.std(ddof=1), (ser>0).mean()))
for name, start, end in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-10-01')]:
 z=ser.loc[start:end]
 print(name,len(z), 'IC %.8f ICIR %.8f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1), (z>0).mean()) if len(z)>1 else 'NA')
# decays
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fw=np.log(px.shift(-h)/px); vals=[]
 for dt in signal.index:
  a=pd.concat([signal.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
 z=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'n',len(z),'IC %.8f ICIR %.8f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)))
# signal artifact for deterministic audit
out=signal.reset_index().rename(columns={'index':'date'}); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20311002_volatility_conditioned_trend_signal.csv',index=False)
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(signal.notna().mean().mean(), signal.rank(axis=1).diff().abs().mean().mean()))
